regimes.name: HEALTHY_SHORT_HOLD
regimes.rule: exit depth is acceptable, price movement controlled, volume not collapsing, data fresh, and no extreme concentration proxy.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Low-risk pools with muted price movement may still hide latent liquidity fragility.

regimes.name: STABLE_FEE
regimes.rule: fee proxy is attractive while price and TVL remain stable and exit depth is acceptable.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Fee-rich periods can fade quickly and reverse into thin-liquidity regimes.

regimes.name: VOLATILE_BUT_LIQUID
regimes.rule: price movement is elevated but exit depth remains acceptable and data is fresh.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Liquidity can deteriorate right after the volatility spike is observed.

regimes.name: TOXIC_FLOW
regimes.rule: abnormal volume spike co-occurs with adverse price move and elevated concentration proxy.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Organic flow bursts may look toxic before the price mean-reverts.

regimes.name: EXIT_DEPTH_THIN
regimes.rule: slippage at 10/20/50 USD is too high or safe exit depth is too small.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Depth can recover rapidly on a thin but active pool.

regimes.name: VOLUME_COLLAPSE
regimes.rule: volume decays hard over 15m/30m/1h and fee proxy becomes unreliable.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Short-term lull can precede a new fee regime.

regimes.name: TVL_DROP
regimes.rule: TVL suddenly drops and liquidity pull risk rises.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Transient TVL dips from rebalancing can mimic a pull.

regimes.name: PRICE_SPIKE_VOLATILE
regimes.rule: price moves exceed thresholds and IL risk is elevated, even when exit depth may still be available.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Fast momentum may briefly overshoot before mean reversion.

regimes.name: WHALE_OR_HOLDER_CONCENTRATED
regimes.rule: holder/trader concentration proxy is high and one actor dominates the pool.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Proxy concentration may overstate risk when direct holder data is unavailable.

regimes.name: DATA_STALE_OR_INCOMPLETE
regimes.rule: mark data is stale or core risk fields are missing.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Temporary ingestion delays may create false stale signals.

regimes.name: UNKNOWN
regimes.rule: no regime can be assigned confidently from available evidence.
regimes.known_false_positive_risk: Unknown may conceal both good and bad pools; treat as research-only.
